scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @hr/shared" "npm run dev -w @hr/api" "npm run dev -w @hr/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @hr/api && npm run build -w @hr/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run start -w @hr/api" "npm run start -w @hr/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @hr/api && npm run typecheck -w @hr/web
scripts.criar-admin: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @hr/api && npm run criar-admin -w @hr/api --
